zh: 成本两两不同，而目标差 target 为正数，所以每个符合条件的无序对 {x, y} 都有唯一的较小值 x 和较大值 y = x + target。
只要从较小值的角度去数：对每个 x 检查 x + target 是否在集合里，这样每个数对恰好被计数一次，不需要枚举所有数对。
把所有成本放进哈希集合；遍历集合中的每个 x，若 x + target 也在集合中就计数加一；输出计数。数值可到 2×10^9，加上 target 后用 64 位整数。
en: The costs are pairwise distinct and the target difference is positive, so every valid unordered pair {x, y} has a unique smaller value x and larger value y = x + target.
Count from the smaller value only: for each x check whether x + target is in the set; each pair is then counted exactly once, with no need to enumerate all pairs.
Put all costs into a hash set; for each x in the set, increment the count if x + target is also present; print the count. Values reach 2*10^9, so use 64-bit integers once target is added.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Put the costs into a hash set; for each x check whether x+target exists. Because target>0, each unordered pair is counted only once, from its smaller value.

## Proof of correctness

If the unordered pair {x,y} has absolute difference equal to the positive target, then there is exactly one smaller value x and one larger value y=x+target. Going through every cost and checking whether it plus target is in the set corresponds one-to-one with the valid value pairs.

## Complexity

Average O(n) time, O(n) space.
